tool_args.rationale: The five paid observations provide variation in both input and gradient and support numerical fitting of the three-parameter two-layer siphon base plus signed square-root branch. The prior execution error came from attempting to fit a prediction row without a y value; this implementation fits only in fit(train_rows) and uses the resulting parameters in predict(row).

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The available five rows span multiple u_now and s_grad values and are sufficient to fit the supplied three-parameter base-plus-sqrt-branch model.
A temporal trajectory batch is unnecessary for the stated short forecast horizon and the source guidance identifies a reduced static siphon law.
This auxiliary measurement is not relevant to identifying the prescribed three-parameter response.
All observed s_grad values are at or below 2.2, below the stated supercritical threshold region; no high-sgrad probe is available in this menu.
Pilot signatures and source subtree guidance support the two-layer siphon mechanism rather than a snapshot Haldane curve.
